fact: A multisectoral commission began work on reforming the 1957 Ley del Registro Civil, on the mandate of the Interministerial Council of 19 November 2025, and the Ministry of Justice said civil registries had recently been set up in all district capitals; the text says nothing of digital entry.
title: Inicia la reforma de la Ley del Registro Civil y de la Ley Orgánica del Poder Judicial de Guinea Ecuatorial
